SAFETY_URGENT_PAIN.title: Seek emergency care now
SAFETY_URGENT_PAIN.body: Sudden severe testicular pain can be an emergency (for example torsion). Go to an emergency department or call emergency services immediately. Do not wait to see if it improves.

SAFETY_URGENT_LUMP.title: See a doctor promptly
SAFETY_URGENT_LUMP.body: A new testicular lump needs prompt in-person assessment. Book an urgent appointment with your doctor or visit urgent care within days, sooner if it changes quickly.

SAFETY_URGENT_SWELLING.title: Seek urgent care
SAFETY_URGENT_SWELLING.body: Rapidly increasing swelling needs urgent in-person assessment. Visit urgent care or an emergency department promptly.

SAFETY_URGENT_FEVER_PAIN.title: Seek urgent care
SAFETY_URGENT_FEVER_PAIN.body: Fever with testicular pain can signal an infection needing prompt treatment. Visit urgent care or your doctor promptly.

SAFETY_URGENT_BLOOD.title: See a doctor promptly
SAFETY_URGENT_BLOOD.body: Blood in semen needs in-person assessment. Book an appointment with your doctor; seek urgent care if bleeding is heavy or you have severe pain or fever.
